units.source_text: 且说薰大将替浮舟办了周年忌辰法事，

en.t: Now Kaoru, the Captain, had held the first anniversary memorial service for Ukifune,

units.source_text: 想起对浮舟的因缘已成空花泡影，不胜感伤，

en.t: and when he thought that his bond with Ukifune had vanished like flowers in the sky and bubbles on water, he was overcome with sorrow,

units.source_text: 便尽力照顾浮舟的异父兄弟，即常陆守的儿子。

en.t: so he did all he could to look after Ukifune's half brothers, the sons of the Governor of Hitachi.

units.source_text: 其成年者擢升为藏人，或者到他自己的大将府里去当将监。

en.t: Those who were grown were promoted to chamberlain, or were taken into his own captain's office to serve as officers.

units.source_text: 其未成年的童子，则拟择其中面貌清秀者作为随从，以供使唤。

en.t: As for the younger boys, he planned to choose the most attractive and refined among them as attendants for his service.

units.source_text: 有一个闲静的雨夜，薰大将去拜访明石皇后。

en.t: On a quiet, rainy night, Kaoru went to visit the Akashi Empress.

units.source_text: 此时皇后身边侍女甚少，两人就随意闲谈。

en.t: At the time there were very few ladies in attendance beside the Empress, so the two spoke together at ease.

units.source_text: 便中薰大将说：“前年我爱上了荒僻的宇治山乡中的一个女子，

en.t: In the course of their talk, Kaoru said, "The year before last I fell in love with a woman in the remote mountain village of Uji,

units.source_text: 外人都讥议我。

en.t: and people outside mocked and criticized me for it.

units.source_text: 但我认为此乃前世因缘，无论何人，心之所爱便是有缘。

en.t: But I believed it was a bond from a former life; whoever the person may be, the one the heart loves is the one with whom one has a karmic tie.

units.source_text: 我相信此理，管自常去访问。

en.t: Trusting in that truth, I went on visiting her often, heedless of others.

units.source_text: 想是那地方不吉之故，遭到了伤心之事。

en.t: Perhaps because that place was ill-omened, I met with a heartbreaking misfortune.

units.source_text: 此后便觉这地方道里辽远，长久不去访问了。

en.t: After that, the road to the place seemed terribly distant, and for a long time I did not go there.

units.source_text: 前几天乘便又去了一次，

en.t: A few days ago, when the chance arose, I went there once more,

units.source_text: 由于屡次在那里痛感无常之故，

en.t: and because I had so often felt there the painful truth of impermanence,

units.source_text: 觉得这圣僧的山庄是特地为欲引起人的道心而建造的。”

en.t: I felt that the holy monk's mountain villa must have been built especially to awaken a religious heart in people."

units.source_text: 明石皇后便想起了那僧都所说之事，觉得薰大将很可怜。

en.t: The Akashi Empress then remembered what the bishop had told her, and felt very sorry for Kaoru.

units.source_text: 便问：“那地方有可怕的鬼怪栖居着吧？

en.t: She asked, "Are there not fearsome spirits living in that place?

units.source_text: 那女子是怎样死亡的？”

en.t: How did that woman die?"

units.source_text: 薰大将推想，她大约觉得两人相继死亡之事很奇怪，所以这样问吧。

en.t: Kaoru guessed that she must find it strange that two people had died one after another, and that this was why she asked.

units.source_text: 便答道：“也许是如此。

en.t: He replied, "Perhaps it was so.

units.source_text: 那样荒僻的地方，必然有恶劣的东西栖居着。

en.t: In such a desolate place, there must surely be some evil thing dwelling there.

units.source_text: 刚才我所说的那女子，死得非常奇怪。”

en.t: The woman I just spoke of died in a very strange way."

units.source_text: 但他并不详说。

en.t: But he did not explain in detail.

units.source_text: 明石皇后想见此事毕竟是他所隐讳的。

en.t: The Akashi Empress realized that, after all, this was something he wished to keep hidden.

units.source_text: 如果叫他知道别人已经闻悉，定然使他不快。

en.t: If she let him know that others had already heard of it, it would certainly displease him.

units.source_text: 她又想起匂亲王当时曾为此事忧愁甚至生病，虽属不该，亦甚可怜。

en.t: She also remembered that Prince Niou had at the time grieved over this affair and even fallen ill, and though it was improper, she pitied him deeply too.

units.source_text: 可知两人都讳言这女子。

en.t: It was clear that both men avoided speaking of this woman.

units.source_text: 因此明石皇后也不好意思再问。

en.t: For that reason, the Akashi Empress felt too embarrassed to ask any more.

units.source_text: 她只悄悄地对小宰相君说：“听大将的口气，

en.t: She only said quietly to Kozaisho no Kimi, "From the Captain's tone,

units.source_text: 他为了那女子的事非常伤心呢。

en.t: he seems terribly hurt over that woman.

units.source_text: 我很可怜他，想把僧都所说的话告诉他。

en.t: I feel so sorry for him that I would like to tell him what the bishop said.

units.source_text: 但恐也许不是这个人，因此未便说出。

en.t: But I fear it may perhaps not be the same person, and so I cannot conveniently speak of it.

units.source_text: 僧都所说的话你全都听到，

en.t: You heard everything the bishop said,

units.source_text: 你可把其中不好听的话隐去，在谈话中乘便告诉他：

en.t: so you might leave out the unpleasant parts and, when the conversation gives you a chance, tell him this:

units.source_text: 僧都曾经说起这样的一件事。”

en.t: the bishop once spoke of such an affair."

units.source_text: 小宰相君答道：“此事皇后都不便对他说，我怎么可以对他说呢？”

en.t: Kozaisho no Kimi answered, "If even Your Majesty finds it difficult to speak of this to him, how could I possibly tell him?"

units.source_text: 明石皇后说道：“这须得因人因时而定，不可一概而论。

en.t: The Akashi Empress said, "Such things must be decided according to the person and the occasion; one cannot speak of them all in the same way.

units.source_text: 且我另外还有不便说的原因。”

en.t: Besides, I have another reason why it is difficult for me to say it."

units.source_text: 小宰相君理会得是匂亲王之事，觉得可笑。

en.t: Kozaisho no Kimi understood that she meant Prince Niou, and found it amusing.
